title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 051 ]

blocks.text: Usually I wake up before my husband and child/children.
I try to exercise every morning, but this is hard because I have other things to do.
I exercise as much as I can.
While my family is sleeping, I am busy in the kitchen preparing breakfast.
After I finish making breakfast, I wake up my husband and child/children, and I help them get ready for work and school.
Sometimes, I often go to work without eating breakfast.
